sv.title: Hammarbys målmönster – specifika minuterna pekas ut
sv.summary: Ett mönster har vuxit fram i Hammarby. Laget är extra effektivt under en specifik period av sina matcher. – Vi är väldigt farliga i just den delen, säger Markus Karlsson till SVT Sport.

en.title: Hammarby's goal pattern – specific minutes singled out
en.summary: A pattern has emerged at Hammarby. The team is especially effective during a specific period of its matches. – We are very dangerous in that particular part, says Markus Karlsson to SVT Sport.
